spans.s:
saira, a. (ī) belonging to the plough 🞄(sīra);
 n. kind of spirituous liquor.

sairandhra, m. waiting man, valet;
 🞄a mixed caste (offspring of Dasya and Āyogava 🞄woman): -ī, f. handmaiden, waiting 🞄woman.

sairā-vat, a. supplied with provision 🞄(Br.;
 comm.).
sairindhra, m., ī, f., v. r. for sairandhra, 🞄m., ī, f..
